claim_boundary: Finite relation experiment. No unconditional generation, new rational point, full descent, or exact rank claim. The measured quotient gives a class-2-rank upper bound only under GRH.

protocol.claim_boundary: Finite relation experiment. No unconditional generation, new rational point, full descent, or exact rank claim. The measured quotient gives a class-2-rank upper bound only under GRH.
protocol.factor_base: All prime ideals above every rational prime<=400000, with canonical rational-prime relations; generation is justified only under the stated Bach GRH hypothesis.
protocol.gate: Prior fixed pilot produced18 exact noncanonical relation rows. Test sustained yield on only this field and measure the full factor-base matrix gap.
protocol.method: Product/remainder tree computes primorial modulo each norm; exact gcd removes all supported prime powers. Replay uses scalar gcd with the primorial on every value.
protocol.population: Every coprime(m,n) with -512<=m<=512 and1<=n<=512, in lexicographic order. The old64-box is included to measure incremental rank exactly.
